instruction: I want to increase the editor font size to 16 in VS Code, please help modify the setting.

metadata.explanation: Task requires modifying VS Code settings to set editor font size to 16. Evaluator uses existing check_json_settings metric to verify the setting is correctly applied in settings.json.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly fetches VS Code settings.json from the standard Linux location (/home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json)
The check_json_settings metric properly verifies that editor.fontSize is set to 16 by loading the JSON and comparing expected key-value pairs
Complete coverage: instruction requires setting font size to 16, evaluator checks exactly that requirement
Expected value is semantically correct: editor.fontSize: 16 matches the instruction requirement
No postconfig needed: VS Code automatically persists settings.json changes to disk
Data flow is correct: vm_file getter extracts the file, metric loads JSON and validates the specific setting
The evaluator will work correctly at runtime with proper error handling for missing files or invalid JSON

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
